en.headline: HK Express passenger suffers minor burn after power bank overheats on Jeju flight
en.dek: Crew placed the device in a fire containment bag and submerged it in water after smoke appeared under a seat as the aircraft approached the airport, and the plane landed safely.
body: A passenger sustained a minor burn to her thumb after a power bank overheated and emitted smoke aboard a HK Express flight from Hong Kong to Jeju on Sunday.

The airline said the incident occurred on flight UO676, which was carrying 236 passengers and seven crew. The power bank was stored in a bag under a passenger’s seat and began overheating as the aircraft approached Jeju International Airport.

Crew members followed standard safety protocols by placing the device in a heat-resistant fire containment bag and submerging it in water, bringing the situation under control. The aircraft landed safely as scheduled. The injured passenger, a woman in her 50s, received first aid after landing and declined ambulance transport, saying she would seek hospital treatment on her own. No other passengers were injured.

HK Express, a subsidiary of Cathay Pacific, confirmed the details and said the situation was controlled. Authorities in South Korea reported that fire crews boarded after landing to confirm there was no further risk.

zh.headline: 香港快運飛濟州航班行動電源過熱冒煙 女乘客拇指輕微灼傷
zh.dek: 飛機接近濟州機場時，座位下方行動電源冒煙，機組人員即時放入防火袋並浸水，航班安全降落，傷者拒絕救護車自行求醫。
body: 周日一架由香港飛往濟州的香港快運航班，有乘客的行動電源在飛行途中過熱冒煙，導致一名女乘客拇指輕微灼傷。
航空公司表示，事件發生在UO676航班上，當時載有236名乘客及7名機組人員。該行動電源放置於乘客座位下方的行李袋內，於飛機接近濟州國際機場時開始過熱。
機組人員隨即按照標準程序處理，將裝置放入耐熱防火袋並浸入水中，情況受控。飛機按原定時間安全降落。傷者為一名五十多歲女子，落地後接受急救，其後拒絕救護車送院，表示自行前往醫院治療。其餘乘客未有受傷。
香港快運（國泰航空附屬公司）證實有關詳情，指情況已受控。南韓方面亦有消防人員在飛機降落後登機確認無進一步風險。
